architecture: ReelBite Autonomous Fault Tolerance & Self-Healing Worker Cluster

experiments.observations: Zero failures occurred; processing executed cleanly within baseline operating parameters.
Worker crash detected in 36ms (MTTD). Autonomous self-healing recreated worker instance in 46ms (MTTR). In-flight stalled job safely redelivered with 0 dropped orders.
Redis disconnect detected in 0ms. Client backoff held worker queue without crashing. Broker reconnected cleanly in 79ms.
3 transient MongoDB failovers intercepted. All 3 transient retries recovered through exponential backoff with zero unhandled errors.

experiments.experiment: Experiment E: High Concurrency Duplicate Submissions
experiments.observations: Processed 60 duplicate job submissions across 20 distinct orders. Atomic distributed locking and dual-state guards suppressed 40 duplicate runs. Exactly 20 restaurant notifications dispatched (Duplicate Count = 0).
